resumen: Sin gestión: lo que pedían queda fuera de mi cometido

eventos.texto: Clínica Arenal, buenos días, good morning.
Hi. I need a GP at Arunal Store. I can only get to store.
Could I have the patient's full name and their DNI or date of birth, please?
Laura Ruiz Gomez, born the 14th of September, 1978.
Ficha encontrada: Laura R. (por la fecha de nacimiento)
Busca la ficha por adelantado, por la fecha de nacimiento (1,00)
Which Arenal site can you reach, or could you give me the address you’ll be coming from?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
